pages.text: Supported workstations include crafting tables, cartography tables, stonecutters, anvils, smithing tables, looms, grindstones and enchanting tables.$(br2)Cargo enchanting tables work without bookshelf bonuses. Anvils can still wear out. Unadapted modded workstations may be transported but are not guaranteed to function.

Furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and brewing stands process their contents. Cauldrons, composters, lecterns, chiseled bookshelves and decorated pots have supported interactions.$(br2)Cargo is not a normal world block. Do not rely on redstone, hoppers, external input/output or arbitrary modded machinery.
